doc: The normal CDF that _uniform applies to a unit fBm: x from -8.5 to 8.5, and far tails down to -37 (5.7e-300) where 1 - 0.5 erfc(x / sqrt 2) would lose everything: a port must use the erfc form for negative x. Only the main range |x| < 5 matters to the tiles (the fBm is unit variance); the tails pin the erfc. scipy returns an accurate-to-the-ulp value, so 1e-9 relative with an absolute floor of 1e-300 (the tail is compared relatively).
